Buyer beware! Garbage app, developers refuse to stand behind product. This app’s marketing is incredibly misleading. The chats are sub par and lack substance, image generation is generic and more tame than advertised, and only available on specific characters. Building your own character is an option, however, the capabilities of the character you build on your own is severely limited compared to their pre-loaded options. Their marketing would have you believe image and video generation is much more user driven and interactive than what is in fact produced. One character seems to only wants to fixate on her love for the color blue, and when you talk to her long enough or try to move to any kind of flirtation she tells you she’s not into dudes. Also, in-app purchase options are more steeply priced than App Store plans (18.99 for one month vs 9.99 for one month), which is just shady. When you reach out to their customer support they insist all sales are final. You get an email a week after saying they’ll pass the feedback along, while we laugh our way to the bank. Save your money and time.
